fixture_scope: Independent /tmp Codex home, real native storage API, user-only items and manual forks; no model requests or user conversations touched.
verified: Visible recent/archived scope controls and explanatory dialog
Native archive preserves user-only stored record and moves native history file
Archived read-only state and explicit restore control
Refresh, search, scope persistence and desktop hit targets
Same-ID restoration enables input and preserves record
Late genuine archived list result cannot overwrite latest recent scope
Native fork-reference deletion refusal has actionable Chinese feedback and raw cause
Cancel sends no delete request; confirm deletes native history
Direct permanent deletion of archived history and no refresh resurrection
Real native thread/list invalid limit produces a retryable error; same-scope retry succeeds and a late native failure cannot overwrite a newer selected scope
Canceled permanent deletion preserves the browser draft text and an actual uploaded-but-unsent text attachment
Successful recent-thread and archived-thread deletion removes that ID from the composer Map and sessionStorage draft record
Permanent deletion preserves another fork and the parent conversation drafts
A genuine native refusal to delete a referenced parent preserves its unsent browser draft
limits: No new model requests: these cases validate storage, browser controls and native lifecycle, not Agent planning or model compatibility.
The inherited parent portion of a fork is a native reference, not a copied string in the child file. Each child has its own explicit native user-only item for byte-level archive preservation checks.
Native refuses deleting a manually forked parent while referenced; Web explains the restriction and preserves data.

preserved_runs.successful-ten-before-draft-cleanup: Ten successful cases before extending the same checks to actual browser draft and attachment cleanup.
